content: Table-stakes portfolio sections: name/positioning statement, hero, 3-5 curated projects with live demos and quantified impact, GitHub links, contact/resume in one click, fast+responsive site. Skill bars viewed as amateurish. SRE/platform roles should show infra-flavored case studies (deployment pipelines, observability dashboards, incident postmortems) with architecture diagrams and trade-off discussion rather than generic frontend/backend breakdowns.
